auditoria.erro: maturity: unknown should be stable; README shows released packages on GitHub releases, Hackage, Homebrew and Stackage LTS. Sonnet's nota also implies PDF input, but the README lists PDF only as output.

final.role: Converts documents between dozens of markup formats (docx, html, epub, org, etc. to Markdown) to feed notes into the hub
final.evidence: Pandoc is a Haskell library for converting from one markup format to another, and a command-line tool that uses this library; release badges for GitHub, Hackage, Homebrew, Stackage LTS.

auditoria.nota: Ingestion converter from docx/html/epub/pptx/xlsx into Markdown before notes enter the hub; it does not read PDF and is not a search tool.
